SELECT t.id, t.subject, t.description, t.status, t.priority, t.contact_id, t.account_id, t.assigned_user,
  t.sla_due_at, t.first_response_at, t.resolved_at, t.created_at, t.updated_at,
  ct.first_name AS contact_first_name, ct.last_name AS contact_last_name,
  co.name AS account_name,
  u.name AS assigned_name,
  t.submitter_name, t.submitter_email,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket_comments tc WHERE tc.ticket_id = t.id) AS comment_count
FROM tickets t
LEFT JOIN contacts ct ON ct.id = t.contact_id
LEFT JOIN companies co ON co.id = t.account_id
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = t.assigned_user
WHERE t.is_archived = false
ORDER BY t.created_at DESC;

SELECT t.id, t.subject, t.description, t.status, t.priority, t.category, t.contact_id, t.account_id, t.assigned_user,
  t.sla_due_at, t.first_response_at, t.resolved_at, t.resolution_notes, t.created_at, t.updated_at,
  ct.first_name AS contact_first_name, ct.last_name AS contact_last_name, ct.email AS contact_email, ct.phone AS contact_phone,
  ct.lead_status AS contact_status, ct.created_at AS contact_created_at,
  co.name AS account_name,
  u.name AS assigned_name,
  ow.name AS account_owner_name,
  rb.name AS resolved_by_name,
  t.submitter_name, t.submitter_email
FROM tickets t
LEFT JOIN contacts ct ON ct.id = t.contact_id
LEFT JOIN companies co ON co.id = t.account_id
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = t.assigned_user
LEFT JOIN users ow ON ow.id = COALESCE(ct.owner_id, co.owner_id)
LEFT JOIN users rb ON rb.id = t.resolved_by
WHERE t.id = $1 AND t.is_archived = false;

SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('open', 'pending')) AS open_count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('resolved', 'closed')) AS previous_count
FROM tickets t
WHERE t.is_archived = false AND (
  ($1::int IS NOT NULL AND t.contact_id = $1) OR
  ($1::int IS NULL AND $2::text IS NOT NULL AND lower(t.submitter_email) = lower($2))
);

FROM opportunities o
LEFT JOIN stages st ON st.id = o.stage_id
WHERE o.contact_id = $1 AND o.is_archived = false
ORDER BY (o.status = 'Open') DESC, o.created_at DESC LIMIT 1;
